## Overview

Built an ensemble prediction model combining XGBoost and stacked logistic regression to predict NCAA tournament game outcomes, achieving 78% accuracy across 10 years of historical matchups. Engineered 40+ differential features from KenPom, EvanMiya, and Barttorvik metrics (adjusted efficiency, ELO, SOS, shooting splits, Four Factors) and applied correlation filtering to reduce multicollinearity.

## Tech Stack
R, XGBoost, tidyverse, caret, KenPom, EvanMiya
